emails.summary: Karthik's daughter had a serious allergic reaction (hospital) after Sunday's walnut brownies; she is allergic to hazelnuts and the Instagram post didn't list them. He wants exact ingredients and a call today on 98400 12345. Health and safety: Amudha should call today and check the recipe and labelling.
emails.draft_reply:
Dear Karthik,

I am so sorry to hear about your daughter, and I'm very relieved she is fine now. Thank you for letting me know. I will call you today on the number you gave to go through exactly what was in the brownies, and I'm checking the recipe and ingredients carefully so I can give you accurate information. I will also review how I list allergens on my posts and packaging.

With sincere apologies,
Amudha
